title: Professional Certificate in Understanding Intellectual Property Rights And Protection
description: Professional certificate course on fundamental texts and legal strategies for intellectual property rights protection.
longDescription: Understand copyright ownership and protection. Analyse trademark ownership and protection. Understand different types of trademarks. Analyse the legal framework of a patent. Analyse the impact of Brexit on intellectual property. This course has been designed to cover rules and regulations framing the ownership and protection of intellectual property rights. In addition to some conceptual elements, the course explores the foundational UK and U.S. legislation practitioners use to prevent copyright infringement and protect a trademark and patent ownership.
